notes.title: Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes:
To my surprise, this game met the thresholds to be tested for the Steam Deck. Being an old title, the initial result was "Unsupported", which I fixed in the recent patch. Probably it also surprised you so long after release.

Now, you can see the green checkmark! Although I will admit, the experience is not as good as in my newest titles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786533/c4d0e37551ebfb8a73e3bb62e4c469a171da5f21.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - 16th May 2025
notes.notes:
- removed "Press to begin" from title screen
- increased font sizes and improved readability
- few more small adjustements
- Steamworks settings adjustments

Those changes are for Steam Deck compatibility.

notes.title: Cats in Heat now available!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113000/Cats_in_Heat/

I'm happy to announce that the game is now available for purchase!
Multiple choices personalize your experience, almost every scene plays out a bit differently.

Don't forget to let me know somehow if you like this game!
Depending on sales and your reception, you might expect more games in similar narrative style.
Oh, if you didn't like something, also let me know so I could improve!

If you happen to encounter any bugs, let me know and I'll fix it ASAP!
You will see the game has A LOT of choices so certain combination might have slipped past my QA testing, I'm just a one person.

~artoonu


Also, check out my other games:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25882/games_by_artoonu/

notes.title: Release on August 25th 2022!
notes.notes:
There are no delays, no changes from my side.
If there will be no outside issues, the game should be available on Thursday, August 25th 2022, which is the day after tomorrow from when I'm writing this! So excited!
The price will be very accessible, just $2.54 after release discount, so maybe spend it on a fun game instead of coffee or snacks?

This project is a little different from previous ones, I hope you'll like it! I really enjoyed production process.

~artoonu
